stations.title: Idris
stations.note: He has to phone the supplier.

stations.title: Old import
stations.text: Could not read the file. Nothing more.

stations.title: Idris
stations.note: Now he knows what to say.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris asks why the card supplier's price list will not read.
The old import gives up with one line and never says what is wrong or where.
You write a tokenizer that cuts the text into pieces, in three tasks.
Now the reader stops at the stray quote and says exactly where it sits.
Same supplier, same list, and Idris can tell them what to fix.
